claims.text: A per-word reward is tuned using a perceptron-like tuning method, which allows for quick post-training adjustments.
The optimal value of the word reward is sensitive to task, beam size, dataset, and language pair, indicating the need for specific tuning for each model.
The tuning process involves varying the word reward score and observing its impact on performance metrics like BLEU scores and length ratios.
